description: Fix mobile responsiveness for all planner and regulator tab files. Independent of FEAT-002 (different files), but depends on FEAT-001 for DashboardShell bottom padding.
steps: MODIFY src/components/planner/DeformationHistoryTab.tsx: (a) Change top header from 'flex items-center justify-between' to 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-start sm:items-center' so the time-range toggle buttons wrap below the title on small screens. (b) Change the bottom stats grid from 'grid-cols-3 gap-4' to 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4' so the three stats stack vertically on phone.

MODIFY src/components/planner/RiskTrendsTab.tsx: Change the bottom flex row from 'flex items-center justify-between' to 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-start sm:items-center' so the description text and 'Generate Trend Report' button don't overlap on narrow screens.

MODIFY src/components/planner/PanelComparisonTab.tsx: Change the analytical summary row at the bottom from 'flex items-center justify-between' to 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-start sm:items-center' so the text and Export button wrap on mobile.

MODIFY src/components/planner/PlanningIntelligenceTab.tsx: (a) Change top header from 'flex items-center justify-between' to 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-start sm:items-center' so the 'Prototype AI Active' badge wraps gracefully. (b) In each scenario card, the inner content div has class 'ml-14' which causes overflow on very narrow screens. Change 'space-y-4 ml-14' to 'space-y-4 sm:ml-14 ml-0'.

VERIFY: The following planner files already have correct responsive classes and need NO changes: PlanningOverviewTab.tsx (grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3, overflow-x-auto on table, grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-3 for map row), MinePanelMapTab.tsx (flex flex-col md:flex-row, w-full md:w-80 for detail panel), MonitoringCoverageTab.tsx (grid lg:grid-cols-3 with full-width map), ReportsTab.tsx (grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3).

MODIFY src/components/regulator/NationalOverviewTab.tsx: (a) Change top header row from 'flex items-center justify-between' to 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-start sm:items-center' so the two filter buttons wrap. (b) Change map container height from 'h-[500px]' to 'h-[280px] sm:h-[500px]' so the national map doesn't dominate mobile screens. (c) The map legend in the bottom-right (absolute positioned div) — add 'max-h-40 overflow-y-auto sm:max-h-none' to prevent it from extending off-screen on small devices.

MODIFY src/components/regulator/MinePortfolioTab.tsx: Change the top action row from 'flex items-center justify-between' to 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-start sm:items-center' so the search input and filter button wrap cleanly on mobile. The table already has overflow-x-auto wrapper — no table changes needed.
MODIFY src/components/regulator/MineDetailTab.tsx: Change map container height from 'h-[500px]' to 'h-[280px] sm:h-[500px]'.

MODIFY src/components/regulator/ReviewCenterTab.tsx: Change the evidence grid from 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-4' to 'grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4' so evidence and attached-reports cards don't cramp on phones.

VERIFY: The following regulator files already have correct responsive classes and need NO changes: MonitoringHealthTab.tsx (grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4, grid lg:grid-cols-2), RegulatorReportsTab.tsx (grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3).

RiskTrendsTab bottom row wraps on mobile

MinePortfolioTab action row wraps on mobile
